missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for the failing POST /v1/orders requests to identify the 500 origin
Order dependency metrics (inventory, payment, postgresql) to rule out downstream causes
candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because the downstream order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders; traces show the same correlation IDs failing at order with 500 and propagating as 502 at the gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause of the order service's 500 is not established; order-side logs/traces were excluded.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s paired with order-service 500s under shared correlation IDs, and metrics show 502s on /v1/checkout with elevated p95 latency. Topology confirms gateway->order. The proximate cause is order-service 500s, but the underlying fault within order is not yet evidenced.
